core_claims.name: renameTyping / liftRenType
core_claims.scope: For arbitrary source and target contexts, renaming preserves external typing whenever corresponding variable lookups have equal types; binder lifting is proved.

core_claims.name: substTyping / liftSubType / instantiateTyping
core_claims.scope: For arbitrary contexts and all typed replacements, simultaneous substitution preserves typing. Single substitution accepts open, non-value arguments; no closedness or value assumption is hidden.

core_claims.name: preservation / preservationMany
core_claims.scope: Any one-step or finite multi-step weak CBV reduction of an externally well-typed raw term preserves its type in the same arbitrary context, including case and fixpoint unfolding.

core_claims.name: progress
core_claims.scope: Every closed Raw 0 term with HasType [] t a is a value or has an actual next term with a Step derivation. No progress claim is made for open variables.

core_claims.name: valueNormal / normalTypedIsValue / safety
core_claims.scope: Values at any scope cannot step. Closed well-typed normal terms are values; after any supplied finite execution of a closed well-typed term, a normal endpoint is a value.

core_claims.name: deterministic
core_claims.scope: Any two one-step reductions of the same Raw n term have equal targets, at every scope and without a typing hypothesis.

core_claims.name: evaluate / evaluateNatural
core_claims.scope: Total fuelled evaluator for closed externally typed terms, returning an actual endpoint, finite trace and either a value proof or an exhaustion marker. Exhaustion is not a divergence certificate.

core_claims.name: additionComputed / multiplicationComputed / loopExhausts
core_claims.scope: Concrete proof-producing evaluations of 2+2 to Just 4, 3*2 to Just 6, and ten fuel inspections of the self-loop to Nothing.

core_claims.name: expansionStep / expansionUntypable
core_claims.scope: Counterexample to subject expansion: an untypable closed natural case with an ignored ill-typed successor branch steps to zero.

exercises.scope: A term typable at every simple type that takes a self-step through general recursion.
Transport typing through the complete nested-identity trace using preservationMany.
A closed normal raw term that is not a value; no typing derivation exists.

deviations: Typed simultaneous substitution replaces named-variable extension, weakening, drop and swap bookkeeping; the actual preservation and closed-progress scopes are retained.
Progress takes the raw term explicitly so that the next term can be returned at runtime despite erased term indices in typing derivations.
The gas accounting is a plain Nat recursion with a trace and finish reason; no exact indexed gas-consumption equality is claimed.
Canonical-form arguments are implemented by appProgress and caseProgress helpers rather than a separate Canonical record or an isomorphism exercise.
